name: plugins
description: Collection of Claude Code plugins including productivity tools, development skills, design, learning, and math problem-solving

plugins.name: claude-code-setup
plugins.description: Analyze codebases and recommend tailored Claude Code automations such as hooks, skills, MCP servers, and subagents.

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Tools to maintain and improve CLAUDE.md files - audit quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current.

plugins.name: example-plugin
plugins.description: A comprehensive example plugin demonstrating all Claude Code extension options including commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP servers.

plugins.name: explanatory-output-style
plugins.description: Adds educational insights about implementation choices and codebase patterns (mimics the deprecated Explanatory output style).

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

plugins.name: learning-output-style
plugins.description: Interactive learning mode that requests meaningful code contributions at decision points (mimics the unshipped Learning output style).

plugins.name: math-olympiad
plugins.description: Solve competition math (IMO, Putnam, USAMO) with adversarial verification that catches what self-verification misses. Fresh-context verifiers attack proofs with specific failure patterns. Calibrated abstention over bluffing.

plugins.name: playground
plugins.description: Creates interactive HTML playgrounds - self-contained single-file explorers with visual controls, live preview, and prompt output with copy button.

plugins.name: project-artifact
plugins.description: Generate and publish a living project status page as a shareable claude.ai artifact backed by a per-project config, so refreshes re-gather live state, redeploy the same URL, and report only the delta.

plugins.name: ralph-loop
plugins.description: Interactive self-referential AI loops for iterative development, implementing the Ralph Wiggum technique. Claude works on the same task repeatedly, seeing its previous work, until completion.

plugins.name: receipts
plugins.description: A personal Claude Code impact report for justifying your usage to a manager or a self-review: what you shipped, which projects it went to, and each project's share of your usage.

plugins.name: session-report
plugins.description: Generate an explorable HTML report of Claude Code session usage - tokens, cache efficiency, subagents, skills, and the most expensive prompts.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, or benchmark skill performance with variance analysis.

plugins.name: mcg-sales-agent
plugins.description: MC Group Data Analyst Agent — ถามข้อมูลยอดขาย Retail/Fashion ผ่าน MCP tools (execute_sql, describe_table). ใช้เมื่อ user ถามเรื่องยอดขาย, สินค้า, แนวโน้ม, สมาชิก, หรือ KPI ของ MC Group. รวม skills: artifact-creator, email-digest, email-template

plugins.name: consolidate-memory
plugins.description: Reflective pass over your memory files — merge duplicates, fix stale facts, prune the index.

plugins.name: docx
plugins.description: Create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx/.dotx files). Supports formatting, tables of contents, tracked changes, find-and-replace, and image insertion.

plugins.name: explain-usage
plugins.description: Explain where this session's tokens went, with one simple chart in plain language. Use when asked for usage breakdown or token analysis.

plugins.name: pdf
plugins.description: Full PDF processing — read, merge, split, rotate, watermark, create, fill forms, encrypt/decrypt, extract images, and OCR scanned PDFs.

plugins.name: pdf-reading
plugins.description: Read, inspect, and extract content from PDF files — text extraction, page rasterization, embedded images/tables/form-fields, and choosing the right strategy for different document types.

plugins.name: pptx
plugins.description: Create, edit, and analyze PowerPoint presentations (.pptx/.potx). Supports slide creation with pptxgenjs, template-based editing, thumbnails, and validation.

plugins.name: xlsx
plugins.description: Create, read, edit spreadsheet files (.xlsx/.xlsm/.csv/.tsv). Supports formulas, formatting, charting, data cleaning, and conversion between tabular formats.

plugins.name: schedule
plugins.description: Create or update scheduled tasks that run automatically. Supports cron-like scheduling — "every day", "each morning", "remind me in an hour", etc.

plugins.name: setup-cowork
plugins.description: Guided Cowork setup — install a matching plugin, try a skill, connect tools. Walks through role selection, plugin installation, and connector configuration.
